statement.p: Find the velocity and acceleration vectors for the motion described by x = 3+5t^{2}, \quad y = 1-5t^{2}, \quad z = 7+4t^{2}.

static.solution:
\vec{v} is given by: \vec{v} = \frac{d}{dt}\,\left((3+5t^{2})\vec i + (1-5t^{2})\vec j + (7+4t^{2})\vec k\right) = 10t\,\mathit{\vec i}-10t\,\mathit{\vec j}+8t\,\mathit{\vec k}.
The acceleration vector \vec{a} is given by: \vec{a} = \frac{d}{dt}\,\vec v = 10\,\mathit{\vec i}-10\,\mathit{\vec j}+8\,\mathit{\vec k}.
